page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is an instance within the ecs.g5 general-purpose server family. Powered by KVM virtualization, it features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a frequency of 2.5 GHz. The server contains 256.0 GB of memory, yielding a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance includes no local disk storage, requiring network-attached block storage for system installation and data persistence. Connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps to handle data traffic across distributed environments. Without discrete GPUs or specialized local storage arrays, hardware resources are distributed evenly across compute and memory components.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation provides resource density suitable for multi-threaded applications requiring standard memory scaling. The absence of local storage places I/O throughput requirements onto network storage attachments. This configuration fits enterprise application hosting, medium-to-large relational database nodes, CI/CD build environments, and containerized web application clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, it is provisioned with 256.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 4.0 GB per vCPU allocation. The server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps and contains no local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached block storage for operating system and data requirements. Given its balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio and dedicated core model, the instance offers balanced compute capacity for enterprise workloads, container orchestration, web application clusters, and relational database servers without requiring specialized hardware acceleration.
